'''MK221''', also known as '''Emmy-Kaye''', was an attendant and [[Nanny droid/Legends|nanny droid]] who served five generations of the [[N'Vaari family]]. MK221 was owned by [[Brinaloy N'Vaari]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|New Order]].
